note: General merchandise / variety overlay on top of ISD Retail Food (RF). Matching uses brand_key equality or prefix after name normalization; multi-token brands also match consecutive tokens. Single-token brands (Target, Walmart) are prefix/equality only so a middle token cannot hijack. Not a City license type. NAICS 2022 455219 names dollar stores and variety stores; 455211 is warehouse clubs/supercenters (Target, Walmart). These stores are inspected because they sell packaged and TCS food, not because they are grocers. Convenience (7-Eleven) and independent corner markets stay Retail food. Independent 'Dollar Express' / 'Dollar City' names are not listed. Amazon Fresh is kept for the join even if the Boston dump has no row.
